# State — bankedActions field + persistence + undo/redo

Second feature for **Main Street: action banking** (CG-0MT3IOPZB005LNAR): add `bankedActions: number` (init 0) to Main Street game state with serialization, legacy backfill 0, and undo/redo snapshot/restore mirroring the `actionsRemaining` pattern. Save/load persists through the existing state serializer — `MainStreetSaveLoad.ts` needs no direct change (it delegates to `serializeMainStreetState`/`deserializeMainStreetState`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC6 · State — `bankedActions` field:** declared on the state interface (near `actionsRemaining`, ~L266/357) and initial state = 0 (~L754).
- **AC6 · State — persistence round-trip:** serialized in `serializeMainStreetState` (~L844) alongside `actionsRemaining`; deserialized with default 0 (`saved.bankedActions ?? 0`, ~L1203).
- **AC6 · State — legacy backfill:** legacy saves without the field backfill to 0 in `migrateSerializedState` (mirror the `actionsRemaining` backfill at ~L1022).
- **AC6 · State — undo/redo snapshot/restore:** `MarketActionSnapshot` in `MainStreetCommands.ts` captures and restores `bankedActions` (interface ~L52, capture ~L84, restore ~L103) so undo/redo at any point restores the pre-banking bank count — no double-banking on redo.
- **AC6 · State — verified by tests:** save/load round-trip and undo/redo round-trip verified by feature 1 tests (pass/fail).

## Minimal Implementation

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts`: field declaration, initial-state 0, serialize, migrate backfill, deserialize default.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetCommands.ts`: add `bankedActions` to `MarketActionSnapshot` interface, `captureSnapshot`, and `restoreSnapshot` (same null-guard pattern as `actionsRemaining`).
- No changes to `MainStreetSaveLoad.ts` (state serializer used as-is).

## Dependencies

- Feature 1 (tests) — tests green first.

## Deliverables

- State + persistence + undo/redo wiring; unit tests passing.

data.description:
# Engine — day-end banking + day-start composition

Third feature for **Main Street: action banking** (CG-0MT3IOPZB005LNAR): compute banking at day end in `processEndOfTurn` (single choke point shared by player and headless/AI paths) and compose banked actions into the day-start budget in `executeDayStart`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1 · Banking on end-of-turn:** every unspent action in the day's budget banks via `bankedActions = min(2, bankedActions + min(actionsRemaining, 1))` computed in `processEndOfTurn` — 0 / some / nearly-all actions taken → remainder banks (3 available, 1 taken → 2 banked); fully-spent day banks 0.
- **AC2 · Cap enforced:** `bankedActions` never exceeds 2 as an engine invariant — further accumulation is discarded; the bank cannot grow past the cap.
- **AC3 · Day-start composition:** at DayStart, the day's budget is `1 base + staff actionsPerTurn bonus + bankedActions (capped 2)` implemented as `actionsRemaining = 1 + gmBonus + Math.min(2, state.bankedActions)` in `executeDayStart` (~L851); banked reserves are consumed as the player spends actions during the day (spending draws down the combined single-counter budget).
- **AC4 · Staff actions used first:** staff-derived actions (General Manager +1 `actionsPerTurn`) are consumed before the base/banked pool; staff bonuses themselves never bank — idle GM day banks exactly 1 (not 2); GM day with 1 spent banks 1; GM day with 2 spent banks 0.
- **AC4 · Both paths bank identically:** player path (`MainStreetTurnController.endTurn` → `processEndOfTurn`) and headless/AI path (`executeFullTurn` → `processEndOfTurn`) share the choke point; in-scope passive AI banks only on leftovers, never deliberately hoards.

## Minimal Implementation

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts`: banking computation in `processEndOfTurn` (before the day-end settle/turn increment); update the DayStart budget at ~L851 to `1 + gmBonus + Math.min(2, state.bankedActions)`.
- Clamp `bankedActions` ≥ 0 and ≤ 2 at the banking step.
- Run as part of `executeFullTurn` so headless/AI simulations exercise the same code path.

## Dependencies

- Feature 1 (tests), Feature 2 (state field exists).

## Deliverables

- Engine banking logic; feature 1 tests green against it.
data.title: Engine day-end banking day-start composition

# HUD — banked counter + GM-aware action tooltip

Fourth feature for **Main Street: action banking** (CG-0MT3IOPZB005LNAR): surface banked actions in the HUD action counter and explain banking in the action tooltip, including the General Manager note.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC5 · UI indicator:** HUD shows a simple banked-action count alongside remaining actions (SLL-positioned, no hardcoded pixels), e.g. `2 actions left (1 banked)`.
- **AC5 · Action tooltip:** `buildActionTooltip` explains "1 action per turn, with up to two turns' unused actions banked", and appends the General Manager +1 note when a GM is employed.
- **AC5 · i18n keys:** new tooltip strings added via `HUD_TOOLTIP_I18N_KEYS` in `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` (no game-scoped string literals; lookups via `t()`).
- **AC5 · no regressions:** existing reduced-motion / mute / accessibility (ARIA label) behavior and helper paths unaffected.

## Minimal Implementation

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts` (~L341): extend the action counter text with the banked count; keep `markHudTransient` + `attachHudTooltipZone` wiring.
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts` (`buildActionTooltip` ~L287): add banking explanation + GM-aware line; register new i18n keys.
- Verify via existing browser test patterns (`tests/main-street/MainStreetScene.browser.test.ts` / HUD tooltip tests).

## Dependencies

- Feature 3 (engine behavior locked).

## Deliverables

- HUD counter + tooltip changes; browser/unit tests green.

# Quality gates — full suite, build, Monte Carlo baseline

Sixth feature for **Main Street: action banking** (CG-0MT3IOPZB005LNAR): verify all quality gates green and re-baseline the Monte Carlo harness if passive AI banking shifts simulation output — drift triaged, never silently accepted (parent AC7 + Risks section).

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC7 · Quality gates (full parent AC7):** unit tests cover banking accumulation, cap enforcement, staff-first ordering, day-start composition, save/load round-trip, and undo/redo (delivered by feature 1); `npm test` passes and `npm run build` succeeds (verified here); related docs updated (delivered by feature 5).
- **AC7 · `npm test` passes:** full suite (incl. `--project unit` + `--project browser` + tutorial E2E) green.
- **AC7 · `npm run build` succeeds:** TypeScript compile + Vite production build complete without errors.
- **AC7 · Monte Carlo baseline:** `npm run monte-carlo` passes, or `docs/main-street/n.json` re-baselined via `scripts/generate-main-street-monte-baseline.ts` with the drift documented (mechanic-driven baseline shift only; no silent acceptance).
- **AC7 · test triage:** any banking-induced test failures triaged on the relevant work items (test-failure triage policy) before `in_review`.

## Minimal Implementation

- Run the full gates; triage banking-induced failures against features 1–4; re-baseline Monte Carlo if the harness legitimately drifts.

## Dependencies

- Features 1–5.

## Deliverables

- Green gates; updated baseline (if needed) + explanation comment.
